system.description: Maybe you've deadened your nerves through Vicissitude, maybe you're a tough bastard, or maybe it turns you on — regardless, you ignore the wound penalties suffered at the Hurt or Injured health levels. You still suffer full wound penalties at Wounded and below. You must have a Conviction or Courage rating of 3 or more to take this Merit. If you also possess the advanced Vicissitude power Ecstatic Agony, you gain no additional dice from it until you are at least Wounded, since your indifference to pain deprives it of its power. In MET terms, you ignore penalties at the Bruised health level.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
